content.comment_body: Can anyone assist? I'm trying to create an analog output that smoothly varies between two defined points, for example between 10mA and 18mA. Ideally, when an input is activated, the analog output would gradually shift within this range—like moving incrementally: 13mA, 13.5mA, 14mA, up to 16mA—rather than stepping suddenly from one value to another. This change should occur over about 30 seconds, then continue to the next variable range. After considering various options, I'm unsure how to achieve this easily or if [product_name] can support it. Any advice or suggestions would be appreciated.

Here is a possible approach. While not truly random, it produces a slow analog change from 100 to 180 and back. Keep in mind, analog outputs in [product_name] use an internal scale of 0 to 1000, where 0 represents 0V (or 0mA) and 1000 equals 10V (or 20mA). Adjust these settings according to your requirements.
